Minneapolis Shooting Leaves Multiple Dead and Injured

A shooting incident in a downtown Minneapolis apartment building resulted in the deaths of two civilians and the suspect. Three police officers were among at least six people injured in the incident. One victim died at the scene, and another died at a hospital. Authorities confirmed the suspect was also dead, though the manner of death was not immediately clear. Witnesses reported hearing multiple gunshots, and local and federal authorities responded to the scene. Seven patients were brought to a nearby hospital.
